messages.content: Who is the CEO of Helios Robotics?
Mira Chen is the CEO of Helios Robotics. She joined in 2019 after leading autonomy programs at Northwind Industrial.
Where is Helios Robotics headquartered?
Helios Robotics is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with a second engineering site in Tampere, Finland.
What is the flagship product of Helios Robotics?
The flagship product is the HX-9 collaborative arm, a 9-axis industrial manipulator rated for 18 kg payload.
What is the cooling loop spec for the HX-9 arm?
The HX-9 uses a closed glycol cooling loop at 8 liters per minute, 18 C inlet, with a maximum delta-T of 6 C under full payload.
What firmware version should HX-9 robots run in production?
Production HX-9 robots must run firmware 4.7.2 or newer. 4.6.x is retired because of a wrist-joint encoder drift bug.
How do I request a maintenance window for an HX-9 cell?
Open a ticket in Helios Service Hub, choose Asset = HX-9, Severity = Planned, and submit at least 12 hours before the window. On-call will page the Tampere duty engineer.
What network ports does the HX-9 controller expose?
The HX-9 controller exposes TCP 4422 for the teach pendant, TCP 8443 for the operator API, and UDP 47808 for BACnet alarms. All other ports should stay firewalled.
What is the emergency stop behavior on HX-9?
An E-stop cuts motor power within 40 ms, holds brakes, and requires a physical key reset at the cell door before software enable.
Who owns the safety PLC program?
The safety PLC program is owned by the Functional Safety team in Milwaukee. Changes require a dual review from Safety and Controls.
What lubricant is approved for the HX-9 harmonic drives?
Use Helios Grease HG-220 only. Third-party lithium greases void the harmonic-drive warranty.
How often should HG-220 grease be replaced?
Replace HG-220 every 2,000 operating hours or 12 months, whichever comes first.
What is the default teach-pendant language pack?
The default teach-pendant language pack is English (US). Finnish and German packs are optional downloads from Helios Service Hub.
Does Helios Robotics support ROS 2?
Yes. HX-9 firmware 4.7.2 ships a ROS 2 Humble driver named helios_hx9. Galactic is not supported.
What is the SKU for the 18 kg gripper kit?
The 18 kg gripper kit SKU is HX9-GRP-18K-B. It includes the force-torque sensor and the ISO flange adapter.
What is Helios Robotics' support phone number?
North America support is +1-414-555-0199. EMEA support is +358-3-555-0170. Both lines are 24/7 for Severity 1 cell-down events.
What does error code HX-441 mean?
HX-441 means wrist encoder mismatch greater than 0.4 degrees. Power-cycle the wrist, then run calibration routine CAL-WRIST-3. If it repeats, replace the encoder harness.
Can the HX-9 operate in a food-grade washdown cell?
Only the HX-9W variant with IP69K covers is rated for food-grade washdown. The standard HX-9 is IP54 and must not be hosed down.
What is the maximum reach of the HX-9?
Maximum reach is 1,350 mm from the base centerline to the tool flange.
Which cloud region hosts Helios telemetry?
Helios telemetry is hosted in eu-north1. Customer tenants in the US still replicate audit logs to us-central1 overnight.
What is the warranty length for the HX-9?
Standard warranty is 24 months from ship date, or 10,000 operating hours, whichever comes first. Extended coverage is sold as SKU HX9-WARR-48.
How do I export a motion trace from the HX-9?
On the teach pendant go to Diagnostics > Trace > Export. Files land on the controller at /var/helios/traces and can be pulled with the operator API on TCP 8443.
Who is the on-call duty engineer rotation owned by?
The Tampere site reliability rotation owns 24/7 duty. Milwaukee covers overflow between 14:00 and 22:00 UTC.
What authentication does the operator API use?
The operator API on TCP 8443 uses mutual TLS with certificates issued by the Helios Internal CA. API tokens are not supported.
Is wireless teach pendant pairing allowed?
No. Wireless pairing is disabled in firmware 4.7.2. Use the tethered pendant on TCP 4422 only.
What is the recovery time objective for a failed HX-9 controller?
RTO is 4 hours if a spare controller is on site, 24 hours if a unit must ship from Milwaukee.
Which oil is used in the HX-9 shoulder gearbox?
The shoulder gearbox is sealed and uses Helios Gear Oil HO-90. It is filled for life and is not a customer service item.
How do I enable debug logging on the ROS 2 driver?
Set HELIOS_HX9_LOG=debug in the driver environment and restart helios_hx9. Logs go to /var/log/helios/ros2.log.
What is the default collision sensitivity?
Default collision sensitivity is 3 on a 1-5 scale. Food-grade HX-9W cells should run at 2 or lower.
Does Helios provide a digital twin?
Yes. Helios Twin runs in the browser and syncs cell state every 250 ms from the operator API. It is licensed as SKU HX9-TWIN.
What is the packing weight of a crated HX-9?
A crated HX-9 with the standard pedestal weighs 410 kg. The HX-9W crate is 445 kg because of the stainless covers.
Which team owns the Helios Internal CA?
Platform Security in Milwaukee owns the Helios Internal CA. Certificate requests go through Service Hub under Identity > mTLS.
What is the minimum compressed air pressure for the HX-9 gripper kit?
The HX9-GRP-18K-B gripper kit needs 6 bar clean dry air, 50 liter per minute peak.
Can two HX-9 arms share a single safety PLC?
Yes, up to two HX-9 arms may share one safety PLC if both cells are in the same hard-guarded zone and the dual-review safety package is applied.
What is the part number for the wrist encoder harness?
Wrist encoder harness part number is HX9-CBL-WENC-04. It is the replacement for HX-441 repeat faults.
How do I update firmware from 4.6.x to 4.7.2?
Back up /var/helios, run helios-fw --target 4.7.2 --precheck, then schedule a 45 minute window. Do not skip 4.7.0; the encoder schema changes in that step.
What Slack channel is used for Severity 1 cell-down events?
Page through Service Hub first. The Slack mirror is #helios-sev1. Do not page individuals directly.
What is the default tool-center-point offset for the 18 kg gripper?
Default TCP offset is X 0 mm, Y 0 mm, Z 182 mm, with yaw aligned to the gripper jaws.
Does the HX-9 support Profinet?
Yes. Profinet IO is available with option card HX9-PN-IO. EtherNet/IP is the factory default.
What is Helios Robotics' fiscal year start?
Helios Robotics fiscal year starts on 1 February.
Who is the VP of Engineering at Helios Robotics?
Aisha Rahman is VP of Engineering. She is based in Tampere and owns firmware, controls, and the ROS 2 stack.
